# Copilot instructions

Follow `AGENTS.md` at the repository root — it holds every rule for this repository (non-negotiables: no real PHI, honest local-only integrations, one action = one Undo, keep `main` green; architecture, testing, plain-git workflow and UI conventions). Read `docs/HANDOFF.md` for current state and next steps. If anything conflicts with `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.md` wins.
